reason: B gives a judge the full picture in ten minutes: it shows the capacity drop in numbers (about 80 tenants a year, about 380 turned away), discloses the county contract risk honestly, shows the grant plus pledge covers 83% of the position, and notes the handover training. A is clean but thinner. It omits the funding risk and promises a represented-vs-unrepresented comparison by the end of year one, which goes beyond what the facts support.
